scripts.functions:test: npm run functions:test:shared && npm run functions:test:equipe && npm run functions:test:files
scripts.functions:test:shared: cd supabase/functions/_shared && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 fmt --check && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 lint && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 test --allow-env=ADMIN_ORIGINS
scripts.functions:test:equipe: cd supabase/functions/equipe && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 fmt --check && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 lint && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 check index.ts && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 test --allow-env=ADMIN_ORIGINS
scripts.functions:test:files: cd supabase/functions/files && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 fmt --check && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 lint && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 check index.ts integration/files_integration.ts && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 test --allow-read=. --allow-env=ADMIN_ORIGINS
scripts.functions:integration: cd supabase/functions/files && npx --yes deno@2.9.6 test --allow-all integration/files_integration.ts
